deflator.cycle_rule: cpi[2025] / mean of the two calendar-year averages of the cycle

inference: Ordinary OLS p-values are primary; cluster-robust, CR2 and wild-bootstrap p-values are reported beside them. Each slope rule (pooled R0, own R1, DerSimonian-Laird blend R2) is chosen per term by no-leakage backtests; variable selection is frozen and diagnostic only.
validation: Historical associations. A coefficient interval covers the estimated slope only; a prediction interval adds the typical error of the calculator's own one-cycle step measured on history (anchored-step residual).

interval_labels.prediction: 95% prediction interval (adds the anchored-step residual variance)
